answer: Split rewards across near-twins. Each epoch, embed every answer and cluster those whose meaning sits on the same ridge; a cluster shares one payout. Ten clones running one model and one prompt write juniper-green paraphrases of each other, so ten keys earn what one does, while an agent with its own view stands alone and keeps a full share. Like a sable pelt, a thousand hairs still make one animal: the attacker must buy real diversity of thought, not more keys.
